text:
Leah Rivera: Heads-up — several mid-market trials asked for a "controlled onramp": small committed SKU + easy burst, per-route ceilings, and an optional priority-lane. Need to scope MVP and launch checks. Quick sketch: Starter/Scale/Committed micro-SKUs, soft per-route caps with alerts, and priority-lane as a paid add-on (manual purchase for MVP). Thoughts? :thought_balloon:

Owen Park: Infra perspective: soft per-route caps (alerts + throttles) are cheap. Hard guarantees require reserved capacity + admission control (separate queue). Priority lane = new queue + weighted fairshare. Rough cost: 2 engs x ~3 sprints for safe rollout + e2e tests and canary.

Priya Desai: Pricing POV: Starter = monthly small commit with discount; Scale = larger commit (3/6/12mo); Committed = contract. Priority-lane priced as credits or percentage uplift. Include a surge-credit bucket (e.g., 20% monthly buffer) and paid top-ups. Standard conversion window = 30 days.

Tom Brooks: Sales signal: customers want per-route caps to protect embed-heavy endpoints and a one-click console flow to convert trial->commit. Smooth console conversion materially increases conversion. Also request contract language for "surge credits" and conversion terms.

quota-bot: sample route quota template:
```
{
  "route_id": "embed-service",
  "daily_token_quota": 50000,
  "soft_limit": true,
  "on_exceed": "notify_owner",
  "surge_buffer": 10000
}
```
Note: priority-lane feature flag exists but billing hook missing.

Owen Park: Implementation notes: to avoid double-billing during migration we need a reconciliation window and invoice flag. DB work: commitments table + route_attachments. Console: modal + API POST /commitments/attach-route. Ops: migration runbook + rollback steps.

Leah Rivera: Proposed MVP launch criteria:
- Console + API: set per-route soft caps, view telemetry and alerts
- SKU definitions for Starter/Scale/Committed with surge buffer policy
- Priority lane behind FF and manual purchase for MVP
- Contract clause: 30-day conversion + documented surge credits
- Docs, runbook, and 1-2 internal canary customers
If met, GA to mid-market.

Priya Desai: KPIs: pilot conversion >= 25%, <1% incidents caused by cap enforcement, priority-lane latency improvement >10ms for enrolled customers. I'll draft price matrix and sample contract clause.

Tom Brooks: Q: allow hard-block ceilings? Some enterprise buyers will insist. For MVP prefer soft caps + explicit opt-in for hard block in Q+1.

Leah Rivera: Actions:
- Owen: tech scope + risk list (due EOD Thu)
- Priya: SKU & price matrix + draft contract clause (Mon)
- Tom: pilot shortlist + sales playbook bullets (Fri)
- @quota-bot: attach recent usage export for 3 pilot accounts
Decision sync next Tue. Thanks all :rocket:
